data.exact_reserve_text: The 2019 Year of Account has unfortunately suffered a material loss from Typhoon Hagibis while following pricing reviews of the casualty account ultimate loss ratios have been reassessed upwards by Asta, which has been validated by Chord Re's approach to pricing the 2020 renewals.

data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development triangle, pre-2019 underwriting years (principally the 2017 year) show a small net adverse prior year development of approximately 0.97 million (0.97m) on opening gross claims outstanding of 76.24m (1.27% strengthening). The syndicate attributes reserve pressure primarily to large natural catastrophe events in 2017 and upward reassessment of casualty ultimate loss ratios, notably following Typhoon and other large loss activity; the movement was calculated from the gross claims development table as no explicit gross prior-year movement note was provided.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was not explicitly stated as a gross movement in a 'movement in prior year's provision' note. The prior-year development number was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims development triangle) printed in the report (triangle values are presented in $'000 in the financial statements though the triangle header shows 'GBP '000'). The triangle was used to compute movement for 2017 only (the only underwriting year qualifying as 'prior' in this 2019 report). Confidence is moderate-high for the triangle-derived figure. No explicit quantified gross prior-year movement note was found.
